title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Stake Increased by Wealth Management -

organizations.name: wealth management - cornerstone wealth management llc

text:
Cornerstone Wealth Management LLC increased its position in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 18,553.3% during the 2nd its most recent 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The firm owned 16,758,709 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after purchasing an additional 16,668,866 shares during the period. Apple accounts for 1.0% of Cornerstone Wealth Management LLC’s portfolio, making the stock its 17th largest holding. Cornerstone Wealth Management LLC owned 0.33% of Apple worth $89,526,000 at the end of the most recent quarter.
Several other hedge funds have also recently made changes to their positions in AAPL. Summit Trail Advisors LLC raised its position in shares of Apple by 17,669.4% during the 1st quarter. Summit Trail Advisors LLC now owns 20,180,694 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $20,181,000 after purchasing an additional 20,067,124 shares during the period. Russell Investments Group Ltd. bought a new stake in Apple in the 1st quarter valued at $830,026,000. SG Americas Securities LLC increased its holdings in Apple by 1,527.6% in the 1st quarter. SG Americas Securities LLC now owns 2,652,244 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $444,993,000 after acquiring an additional 2,489,285 shares during the last quarter. Mackay Shields LLC bought a new stake in Apple in the 1st quarter valued at $332,905,000. Finally, Harvard Management Co. Inc. bought a new stake in Apple in the 1st quarter valued at $283,972,000. Hedge funds and other institutional investors own 58.61% of the company’s stock.
